# Crisp Video

> Crisp Video restores, denoises and upscales old, low-res video to 4K offline on a Mac, then lets you edit it on a real timeline. Free to use: upscaling, restoring and colour exports up to 60 seconds, everything else at full length, all with a small “Made with Crisp” mark; Pro is $129 once, not a subscription. macOS 14.0 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later).

## Product and pricing
- [Crisp Video](https://crispvideo.app/): what it does, real before/after clips, and the free download
- [Pricing](https://crispvideo.app/#pricing): Free — the full editor, the full preview and the standard enhancement lanes; upscaling, restoring and colour exports stop at 60 seconds, everything else runs at full length, and every export carries a small “Made with Crisp” mark. Pro — $129 once, every 1.x update included; removes the mark and the limit and adds the generative Max lane and batch processing
- [Founding price](https://crispvideo.app/#buy): $64.50 for the first 25 buyers (50% off, until 2026-11-25 UTC) — the Buy button applies FOUNDINGCRISP at checkout; if it ever doesn't, choose “Have a discount code?” and enter it
- [Pay in four](https://crispvideo.app/#buy): Klarna or Afterpay at checkout in the US — $129 as 4 payments of $32.25, two weeks apart (founding: 4 × $16.13)
- [System requirements](https://crispvideo.app/#download): macOS 14.0 or later; Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
- [Licence terms](https://crispvideo.app/legal/terms/): one Pro licence runs on up to 3 Macs at a time
- [Refunds](https://crispvideo.app/legal/refunds/): email within 30 days of purchase for a refund, no reason needed
- [Download for Mac](https://github.com/mattkerr09/crisp-site/releases/download/v1/Crisp.dmg): the current release, 1.0.1647
- [FAQ](https://crispvideo.app/#faq): memory, speed, the Max lane, privacy, licensing

## How-to guides
- [How-to guides for video on a Mac](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/): every guide, by task
- [How to restore old film footage on a Mac: dust, flicker](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/restore-old-film-footage-mac/): Clean up an old film or video transfer on a Mac: remove single-frame dust and blotches, steady the brightness flicker, and upscale.
- [Fix blurry or pixelated video on a Mac: what works](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/fix-pixelated-video-mac/): Fix pixelated or blurry video on a Mac: it is missing detail, so no setting turns it off.
- [Upscale video on a Mac, 480p to 1080p or 4K: free](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-video-on-mac/): Upscale video on a Mac, from 480p to 1080p or 4K: free, offline, no upload.
- [How to upscale a finished edit to 4K on a Mac: offline](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-a-finished-edit-to-4k-mac/): Edit your video on a timeline and upscale the whole finished cut to 4K in one export with Crisp, Enhance or generative SeedVR2 Max, 100% offline.
- [How to batch upscale videos on a Mac (2026)](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/batch-upscale-videos-mac/): Batch upscale videos on a Mac: test on one clip first, avoid filename collisions, and know why a big queue takes as long as it does.
- [Stabilize shaky video on a Mac: the best free option](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/stabilize-shaky-video-mac/): Stabilize shaky video on a Mac and pick the best stabilizer: what software can and cannot fix, what it costs in framing, jello, and the free ffmpeg option.
- [Deinterlace video on a Mac, and what interlacing is](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/deinterlace-video-mac/): Deinterlace video on a Mac, and what interlacing is: how to tell comb teeth from look-alikes, the ffmpeg check, and why a file's flag can lie after re-encoding.
- [How to compress a video on a Mac: free, offline, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/compress-video-on-mac/): Compress a video on a Mac to make the file smaller for email or upload, one tap, 100% offline, nothing uploaded.
- [How to convert MOV to MP4 on a Mac (2026): free, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/convert-mov-to-mp4-mac/): Convert MOV to MP4 on a Mac in one tap, 100% offline, usually losslessly with Pro.
